points.title: 童年与早期教育
points.description: 威廉·詹姆斯于1842年1月11日出生于纽约市一个富裕的知识分子家庭。他的父亲亨利·詹姆斯是一位神学家和哲学家，母亲玛丽·沃尔什·詹姆斯是一位虔诚的基督徒。詹姆斯是家中五个孩子中的长子，弟弟后来成为著名小说家亨利·詹姆斯。童年时期，詹姆斯频繁随家人在欧洲旅行，接受多语言教育，这培养了他开阔的国际视野。然而，他的童年并不快乐，健康状况不佳，且面临严重的家庭经济压力，这些经历对他后来的哲学思想产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: William James was born on January 11, 1842, in New York City to a wealthy intellectual family. His father Henry James Sr. was a theologian and philosopher, and his mother Mary Walsh James was a devout Christian. As the eldest of five children (his younger brother would become the famous novelist Henry James), William frequently traveled with his family in Europe during his childhood, receiving a multilingual education that cultivated his broad international perspective. However, his childhood was unhappy, marked by poor health and significant financial pressures that profoundly influenced his later philosophical thinking.

points.title: 医学学习与精神危机
points.description: 1861年，詹姆斯进入哈佛医学院学习，但期间多次中断学业前往欧洲。1864-1865年，他在德国学习医学，受到赫尔姆霍茨等生理学家的影响。1867年，他前往巴西进行科学考察，研究黄热病。然而，詹姆斯长期受到抑郁症和存在主义危机的困扰，多次质疑人生的意义和目的。1869年，他获得哈佛医学院医学学位，但发现自己无法从事医疗实践，这一时期的精神危机促使他转向哲学和心理学研究，寻找解决人类精神困境的途径。
points.descriptionEn: In 1861, James entered Harvard Medical School, but interrupted his studies multiple times to travel to Europe. From 1864-1865, he studied medicine in Germany, influenced by physiologists like Hermann von Helmholtz. In 1867, he traveled to Brazil for a scientific expedition to study yellow fever. However, James suffered from long bouts of depression and existential crisis, frequently questioning the meaning and purpose of life. In 1869, he earned his M.D. from Harvard but found himself unable to practice medicine, prompting his mental crisis to lead him toward philosophy and psychology in search of solutions to human spiritual dilemmas.

points.title: 哈佛教学生涯
points.description: 1872年，詹姆斯开始在哈佛大学担任生理学讲师，后转向哲学和心理学教学。1875-1876年，他在哈佛开设了美国第一门心理学课程，被视为美国心理学之父。1882年，他成为哈佛哲学教授。这一时期，詹姆斯完成了他的重要著作《心理学原理》(1890)，这部著作将心理学确立为一门独立学科，并提出了著名的'意识流'理论。他还发展了实用主义哲学思想，强调思想的价值在于其实际效果。詹姆斯在哈佛培养了众多学生，包括后来的哲学家约翰·杜威，对美国学术界产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1872, James began teaching physiology at Harvard University before shifting to philosophy and psychology instruction. From 1875-1876, he offered the first psychology course in America at Harvard, earning him the title 'father of American psychology.' In 1882, he became a professor of philosophy at Harvard. During this period, James completed his seminal work 'The Principles of Psychology' (1890), which established psychology as an independent discipline and introduced his famous theory of the 'stream of consciousness.' He also developed pragmatic philosophy, emphasizing that the value of ideas lies in their practical consequences. James mentored numerous students, including future philosopher John Dewey, exerting profound influence on American academia.

points.title: 晚年创作与影响
points.description: 1907年，詹姆斯从哈佛退休后搬到新罕布什尔州的查尔斯顿，专注于写作。这一时期，他完成了《宗教经验之种种》(1902)，探讨了宗教体验的心理学基础，以及《实用主义》(1907)，系统阐述了他的哲学思想。詹姆斯还积极参与社会活动，支持和平主义和妇女选举权运动。他的健康逐渐恶化，但仍然保持活跃的学术和社会参与。1910年8月26日，詹姆斯因心脏病发作在查尔斯顿去世，享年68岁。他的去世标志着美国哲学黄金时代的结束，但他的思想继续影响了20世纪的哲学、心理学和文学领域。
points.descriptionEn: After retiring from Harvard in 1907, James moved to Chocorua, New Hampshire, where he focused on writing. During this period, he completed 'The Varieties of Religious Experience' (1902), exploring the psychological foundations of religious experience, and 'Pragmatism' (1907), systematically articulating his philosophical ideas. James also remained socially active, supporting pacifism and women's suffrage. His health gradually declined, but he maintained active academic and social engagement. On August 26, 1910, James died of heart failure in Chocorua at age 68. His death marked the end of the golden age of American philosophy, but his ideas continued to influence 20th-century philosophy, psychology, and literature.

points.title: 思想遗产
points.description: 威廉·詹姆斯去世后，他的思想产生了深远影响。他创立的美国实用主义哲学成为美国本土最重要的哲学传统，影响了杜威、米德等后续哲学家。他的心理学理论为行为主义和认知心理学奠定了基础。詹姆斯的'意识流'概念直接影响了现代文学，特别是意识流小说的发展。他的宗教心理学研究开创了宗教经验科学研究的先河。20世纪中叶，詹姆斯的思想经历了复兴，特别是在存在主义和人本主义心理学领域。今天，他被公认为美国最具原创性和影响力的哲学家之一，其跨学科的思想方法继续影响着当代学术界。
points.descriptionEn: After William James's death, his ideas exerted profound influence. The American pragmatism he founded became the most significant indigenous philosophical tradition in the United States, influencing subsequent philosophers like John Dewey and George Herbert Mead. His psychological theories laid the foundation for behaviorism and cognitive psychology. James's concept of the 'stream of consciousness' directly influenced modern literature, particularly the development of stream-of-consciousness fiction. His religious psychology research pioneered the scientific study of religious experience. In the mid-20th century, James's ideas experienced a revival, especially in existential and humanistic psychology. Today, he is widely regarded as one of America's most original and influential philosophers, with his interdisciplinary approach continuing to shape contemporary academia.

supporter.zh: 威廉·詹姆斯被赞誉为美国最伟大的哲学家之一，他创立的实用主义哲学为美国思想提供了独特的本土视角。他的心理学研究开创了美国心理学的新纪元，将心理学确立为一门独立科学。詹姆斯的思想强调经验、行动和实际效果，为解决哲学和心理学中的二元对立提供了新路径。他的宗教心理学研究为理解人类精神体验提供了科学框架，而他的意识流理论则直接影响了现代文学的发展。詹姆斯的跨学科思维和人文关怀使他成为连接科学与人文学科的桥梁，对后世产生了不可估量的影响。
supporter.en: William James is celebrated as one of America's greatest philosophers, whose pragmatism provided a unique indigenous perspective to American thought. His psychological research pioneered a new era in American psychology, establishing it as an independent science. James's emphasis on experience, action, and practical consequences offered new pathways to resolve dualisms in philosophy and psychology. His religious psychology provided a scientific framework for understanding human spiritual experiences, while his stream-of-consciousness theory directly influenced modern literature. James's interdisciplinary thinking and human concern made him a bridge between sciences and humanities, exerting immeasurable influence on subsequent generations.

critic.zh: 批评者指出威廉·詹姆斯的实用主义哲学存在相对主义倾向，可能导致道德标准的主观化和相对化。他的心理学理论被认为缺乏严格的科学方法，过于依赖内省和主观报告。詹姆斯对宗教经验的解释被批评为过度心理学化，忽视了宗教的超自然维度。此外，他的思想体系被认为不够系统化，有时存在内在矛盾。詹姆斯对科学乐观主义的批判虽然深刻，但被一些批评者视为对科学进步的过度怀疑。他的个人主义倾向也被认为可能忽视了社会结构和集体因素在人类行为中的重要性。
critic.en: Critics point out that William James's pragmatism exhibits relativist tendencies that could lead to the subjectivization and relativization of moral standards. His psychological theories are criticized for lacking rigorous scientific methods, relying too heavily on introspection and subjective reports. James's interpretation of religious experiences has been criticized as overly psychologized, neglecting the supernatural dimensions of religion. Additionally, his philosophical system is seen as insufficiently systematic, sometimes containing internal contradictions. While his critique of scientific optimism was profound, some critics viewed it as excessive skepticism toward scientific progress. His individualistic tendencies are also seen as potentially overlooking the importance of social structures and collective factors in human behavior.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，威廉·詹姆斯被定义为一位跨学科的先驱，其思想跨越了哲学、心理学和宗教研究的边界。他被视为美国实用主义哲学的奠基人，这一哲学传统后来成为美国思想的核心特征之一。詹姆斯的心理学贡献使他被誉为'美国心理学之父'，他的意识流理论影响了现代文学的发展。在流行文化中，詹姆斯的思想经常被引用来讨论宗教经验、个人选择和人生意义等话题。他的形象既是一位严谨的学者，也是一位富有洞察力的思想家，其著作至今仍在学术界被广泛研究和讨论。詹姆斯的跨学科方法使他成为现代学术分科之前的最后一位通才之一。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, William James is defined as a pioneering interdisciplinary thinker whose ideas spanned philosophy, psychology, and religious studies. He is regarded as the founder of American pragmatism, a philosophical tradition that later became one of the defining characteristics of American thought. James's psychological contributions earned him the title 'father of American psychology,' and his stream-of-consciousness theory influenced the development of modern literature. In popular culture, James's ideas are frequently cited in discussions about religious experience, personal choice, and the meaning of life. His image embodies both a rigorous scholar and a insightful thinker, whose works continue to be widely studied and discussed in academia. James's interdisciplinary approach makes him one of the last 'polymaths' before the modern era of academic specialization.

self.zh: 真理是我们思想的方式，只要它们帮助我们与经验的其他部分建立满意的关系。
self.en: Truth is what works in the way of belief. It is that which guides us practically through the world.

others.zh: 威廉·詹姆斯是美国思想史上最伟大的原创思想家之一，他的实用主义哲学为美国提供了独特的思想遗产，至今仍在影响着我们的思维方式。
others.en: William James was one of the most original thinkers in American intellectual history, and his pragmatic philosophy provided a distinctive intellectual legacy for America that continues to influence our ways of thinking today.
